build_patchembed_2d: build a PatchEmbed module that converts 2D images into patch embeddings using a Conv2d projection layer
build_patchembed_3d: build a PatchEmbed3D module that converts 3D video tensors into patch embeddings using a Conv3d projection layer
create_patchembed_forward: create a forward pass through PatchEmbed to flatten and transpose 2D image patches into sequence format
create_patchembed3d_forward: create a forward pass through PatchEmbed3D to flatten and transpose 3D tubelet patches into sequence format
review_patchembed_classes: review the PatchEmbed and PatchEmbed3D classes and their Conv2d and Conv3d projection layer configurations
